title: Gallery
description: Photos and videos displayed in the gallery.

webUrl.description: URL or relative path to the photo or video web-size file.

downloadUrl.description: URL or relative path to the photo or video full-size file.

previewUrl.description: Optional URL or relative path to a preview of the photo or video, such as a thumbnail image or short preview clip.

width.description: Optional display width in pixels of the web-size image (or the video preview image). Used to reserve the tile's space before it loads.

height.description: Optional display height in pixels of the web-size image (or the video preview image). Used to reserve the tile's space before it loads.

category.description: Gallery section in which this item will appear.

isFavorite.description: Flag to determine if item will be included in favorites section.
